links.outcome: Standalone LLM vs pediatrician diagnostic accuracy in pediatric ECG interpretation
links.effect: Pediatrician accuracy 78.7% vs ChatGPT 71.9%, Copilot 66.9%, Gemini 50.0%; AUC 0.79 vs 0.70, 0.63, 0.54. Gemini false negative rate 39.9%, Copilot false positive rate 24.7%.
links.quote: The pediatrician achieved the highest accuracy (78.7%), followed by ChatGPT (71.9%), Copilot (66.9%), and Gemini (50.0%).

links.outcome: Comparison of candidate LLMs against a pediatrician on same ECG data
links.effect: Pediatrician outperformed all three LLMs (accuracy 78.7% vs 71.9%, 66.9%, 50.0%); accuracy varied markedly across models.
links.quote: The clinician outperformed the LLMs in pediatric ECG interpretation.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and error patterns of general-purpose LLMs on pediatric ECG interpretation in a benchmark dataset compared to a pediatrician.
